plan.title: bug(check,release): DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE leaks into ts:check-lane and misnames Step 5 cause

narratives.Description: bug(check,release): DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE leaks into ts:check-lane and misnames Step 5 cause
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

`ts:check-lane` inherits the agent session pin `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE`. When that pin names a hidden or ineligible brief, hook/scope tests fail and `task release` Step 5 goes red on a laptop cut that is green in CI.

Observed on the v0.118.1 cut of deftai/directive (2026-09-14). Session pin was `xbrief/active/2026-09-13-4383-designsetupscope-decompose-requires-swarmfile-scope-at-autho.xbrief.json` (hidden / not eligible). Four tests failed:

- `packages/core/src/hooks/scope.test.ts` (3): `inspectActiveScope` returned `ready: false` / `path: null`; one denial quoted the session pin instead of the temp-project fixture (`DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE does not name an eligible running xBRIEF ... got ...4383...`).
- `packages/cli/src/hook-host-identity-lifetime.test.ts` (1): expected `write-ready` / `allow`, got `scope-not-ready` / `deny`.

Unsetting `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` for the same HEAD made Step 5 green. Three prior Step 5 runs (~13 min each) had failed.

`sanitizeTsLaneEnv` in `packages/core/src/ts-check-lane/run-lane.ts` already strips release-bypass keys (`DEFT_ALLOW_DEFAULT_BRANCH_COMMIT`, `DEFT_RELEASE_PREFLIGHT`, check-mode). It does not strip `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE`. CI never sets that pin, so origin/master stays green.

## Named-cause companion

`extractGateCause` (`packages/core/src/check/named-cause.ts`) takes the first line matching `\bFAIL\b`. Extra-coverage D7 tests print `FAIL: xbrief/completed/2026-09-07-deliberately-bad-1.2.3.xbrief.json` on purpose (`runConformance` stderr). Step 5 named that ghost file as the cause. The file was never on the worktree. Isolated `extra-coverage` + `roundtrip` tests passed. The real vitest summary was the four hook/scope failures above.

## Expected

- `ts:check-lane` / `pnpm run test` from an agent session that has `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` set do not fail hook/scope tests that use their own temp project.
- `sanitizeTsLaneEnv` strips `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` (and any other session pin that tests must set themselves).
- Step 5 named-cause does not report extra-coverage D7 expected `FAIL` as the gate cause when the real failure is a vitest assertion elsewhere.

## Actual

Session pin leaks into vitest. Named-cause reports a D7 fixture filename. Operators chase a file that does not exist.

## Acceptance

- `sanitizeTsLaneEnv` drops `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE`. Tests that need the pin set it in-process.
- A regression covers: env pin set to an ineligible path, then `inspectActiveScope` / host-identity tests still pass on their temp roots.
- `extractGateCause` prefers a vitest failed-test / assertion summary over an earlier `FAIL:` line from a passing extra-coverage D7 `runConformance` print. Extra-coverage MAY `--quiet` that CLI; either is enough if Step 5 no longer names the deliberately-bad fixture when another test failed.
- CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]`.
- Does not strip occupancy / `DEFT_SESSION_ID` from operator `session:start` itself -- only the lane spawn env.

## Out of scope

- Recutting v0.118.1.
- `#4285` leftover-WIP `verify:ac` poison (different gate, different injector).
- Changing D7 filename rules.

## Workaround (this cut)

```
Remove-Item Env:DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE
task release -- 0.118.1 --summary "..."
```

## Origin

v0.118.1 framework cut, 2026-09-14. Refs #4265.

## Verdict

The named premise survives.

Re-verified at 49399fe420414b75f349d232784bec26491abb4d:

- `TS_LANE_POISON_ENV_KEYS` is still the five release/check-mode keys (`DEFT_ALLOW_DEFAULT_BRANCH_COMMIT`, `DEFT_RELEASE_PREFLIGHT`, `DEFT_CHECK_MODE`, `DEFT_CHECK_AC_ONLY`, `DEFT_HYGIENE_ADVISORY`). No `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE`.
- `inspectActiveScope` `pinFrom` reads `process.env` when `options.env` is omitted. A non-empty pin wins over the temp project's scanned briefs and returns `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE does not name an eligible running xBRIEF`.
- Direct vitest of `packages/core/src/hooks/scope.test.ts` with the filed pin `xbrief/active/2026-09-13-4383-designsetupscope-decompose-requires-swarmfile-scope-at-autho.xbrief.json` failed 3 of 11. The denial test received that missing-pin message (got the 4383 path) instead of `only 'running'`. The eight tests that pass `{ env: {} }` or their own pin still passed.
- `directiveFreeChildEnv` copies `process.env` and deletes `DEFT_SESSION_ID`, `DEFT_SESSION_RITUAL_SKIP`, `DEFT_HOOK_READ_ONLY`, `DEFT_SESSION_POSTURE`. It does not delete `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE`. `decideHook` uses `input.environ ?? process.env`. `mergeHookDispatchEnviron` returns undefined when stdin has no env bag, so hook-dispatch omits `environ` and the Write-hook child sees the shell pin against the temp fixture.
- `dispatcher-spawn-dest.test.ts` still passed 42/42 with the same pin. Those tests pass hook `environ` bags. Do not treat dest-spawn as part of this failure set.

Existing choke: `sanitizeTsLaneEnv` (#2434 / #4230). Existing isolation: `options.env` bags next to the passing scope tests. The miss is the poison-key list plus the older omitted-env calls.

Primary close stays: add `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` (`ACTIVE_SCOPE_PIN_ENV`) to `TS_LANE_POISON_ENV_KEYS`. That is the #1553 / #2434 class (session/release env into the vitest tree). CI never sets the pin, which is why origin/master stayed green.

## 1. Sanitizer unit test is not the inspectActiveScope regression (sharpens-framing)

Evidence: root `package.json` `"test"` is `vitest run --coverage`. Only `ts:check-lane`'s default pnpm spawn calls `sanitizeTsLaneEnv`. Direct `pnpm run test` / `pnpm exec vitest` inherit the shell pin. The live 3-fail run was that in-process case. A unit test that the key is undefined after sanitize does not make `inspectActiveScope(tempRoot)` pass while `process.env` still holds the pin. Host-identity still spreads the pin into the hook-bin child via `directiveFreeChildEnv`.

Failure mode: implementer lands only the poison-key add plus a sanitizer expect. Step 5 goes green through the lane spawn. The named regression is either not the AC, or it fails. An agent session that runs vitest without the lane still sees the three scope failures and the host-identity `scope-not-ready` deny.

Disposition: bind two measured closes, not one. (1) `TS_LANE_POISON_ENV_KEYS` includes `ACTIVE_SCOPE_PIN_ENV`. (2) the omitted-env `inspectActiveScope` calls and `directiveFreeChildEnv` do not consult an ambient ineligible pin. Keep Expected `pnpm run test` only if (2) is in the contract. Do not treat (1) as implying (2).

## 2. First FAIL-word hit cannot prefer a vitest summary (sharpens-framing)

Evidence: `extractGateCause` takes the first useful line matching a FAIL word or a Tests word (`packages/core/src/check/named-cause.ts`). Combined stream is stderr then stdout. D7 extra-coverage prints `FAIL:` plus the error (`conformance.ts`); `runConformance` writes `FAIL:` to stdout (`main.ts`). The #4230 test already prefers a FAIL line over a banner; `FAIL: xbrief/completed/2026-09-07-deliberately-bad-1.2.3.xbrief.json` is that class. The failing D7 fixture test calls `runConformance` without `--quiet`; `--quiet` is used on a D7-allowed name.

Failure mode: `--quiet` as the only close hides the D7 CLI print when extra-coverage itself is the failing test, and it does not help any other passing `FAIL:` CLI under test. A second generic FAIL-word find still names the ghost file.

Disposition: bind a vitest-shaped preference (failed-file line, assertion, or `Tests  N failed`) over `FAIL:` CLI prints when both exist. Keep extra-coverage `--quiet` optional. Do not recut D7 filenames.

## 3. Do not sweep session env (footnote)

Evidence: AC already says do not strip occupancy / `DEFT_SESSION_ID` from `session:start`; only the lane spawn. Expected also says "any other session pin that tests must set themselves" with no list. Occupancy tests already `vi.stubEnv` `DEFT_SESSION_ID`. `directiveFreeChildEnv` already deletes `DEFT_SESSION_ID` for hook children.

Failure mode: a sweep of `DEFT_*` into `TS_LANE_POISON_ENV_KEYS`, or stripping the pin from `session:start`.

Disposition: name `ACTIVE_SCOPE_PIN_ENV` (and only another key after a measured vitest leak). Leave occupancy on its own pin.

## 4. "No active artifact" is not a detector (footnote)

Evidence: with the filed pin set, `reports no active artifact` still passed. Empty temp root plus an ineligible pin still returns `ready: false` / `path: null`; the test does not read the message. The denial test is the detector (it quoted the 4383 path).

Failure mode: a later pin leak that only changes the message on the empty-root case stays green.

Disposition: do not count that test as coverage of this close.

## Road not taken

Rejected: fix only the tests (`{ env: {} }` on the three omitted-env calls, add the pin to `directiveFreeChildEnv`) and leave `sanitizeTsLaneEnv` as release-bypass-only.

Steelman: production hooks already pass `env: environ`. The three failures are unit tests of the omitted-env CLI fallback. Local isolation is the smaller edit and already exists next to the passing calls. A lane-wide strip is blunt.

What would flip that rejection: a suite-wide pin in an agent session that any future omitted-env call would hit. That is the measured v0.118.1 cut (CI green, three ~13 min Step 5 reds, unset pin and Step 5 green). That is the #2434 choke, so the sanitizer is the primary close; test isolation is the regression's assertion surface, not a substitute.

What would flip: #4007 fail-closed is that rule. The measured v0.118.1 cut is omitted-env tests consulting the shell pin, not a production pin-semantics bug. Test isolation is the close; production fail-closed stays.
